inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Restore a saved case input and display its validated physical result.

caseId.description: Opaque page-lifetime identity returned by the matching list/begin operation.

sideEffects: Replaces current input and displayed result.
limitations: Case IDs are page-local and invalidated by external archive replacement; list again after changes.
Host must be idle; revision checks do not establish physical accuracy.
